gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-malayalam: Conthrax draws its diagonals with the same force as its verticals, and the lowercase a opens wide. Anek Malayalam is the quieter sans-serif, with curve tips that never touch and capitals barely above the lowercase.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu builds its reading rhythm from wide, round bowls whose ends stay open like an unlatched hook. Conthrax holds every curve at a single weight, so the heading feels machined beside that softer body.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anuphan: No calligraphic shading anywhere: Conthrax is cut geometric and clean, with a wide-mouthed lowercase a. Anuphan is the friendlier sans-serif, with big round bowls and curves that leave clear gaps.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-arimo: Arimo reads plainly, its sans-serif letters leaving spacious gaps at the ends of rounded glyphs. Conthrax cuts stems and curves from one gauge of tubing, and that gives the heading its machined, geometric stamp.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-athiti: Conthrax opens its lowercase a wide and keeps capitals close to lowercase height. And Athiti, a sans-serif with a see-through s and a high mean line, carries the text below.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Approachable describes Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, a sans with open counters that breathe, paired with Conthrax, whose strokes show constant pen pressure. Mono spacing stretches wide while Conthrax stays uniform and machined.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Conthrax never thins a join, so every junction looks machined and solid. Carrois Gothic SC, a sans-serif whose curves open clearly at each end and whose capitals sit close to lowercase height, softens that rigidity.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-chocolate-classic: Conthrax has a monoweight skeleton, with a wide-mouthed lowercase a and capitals that barely stand above the lowercase. Chocolate Classical Sans adds a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-cossette-texte: Conthrax is geometric and clean, with a wide-mouthed lowercase a. Cossette Texte, a sans-serif with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes and a prominent x-height, gives the text below it more room to breathe.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-fresca: Conthrax is geometric and clean, its wide-mouthed lowercase a making a line read like one thread. And Fresca, with short ascenders above big bowls, can be set a step larger to let its open apertures show.
